article_ref: The Producer Responsibility Obligations (Packaging and Packaging Waste) Regulations 2024, S.I. 2024/1332, regs. 23-25
title: United Kingdom: packaging producer registration only, above threshold
summary: A UK-established business that supplied or imported more than 25 tonnes of packaging in the previous year AND had worldwide turnover of £1 million or more must register with the environmental regulator and report packaging data. This requirement covers registration only; additional duties for large producers are tracked separately. Below both thresholds there is no pEPR registration obligation.

required_evidence.label: Proof of registration with the environmental regulator

sources.note: Fetched the statute directly, resolving the note in the previous draft that the S.I. number was unconfirmed: it is S.I. 2024/1332. Reg. 23 defines 'large producer' and 'small producer'; reg. 24(2) sets the small-producer threshold this requirement models — more than £1,000,000 turnover in the relevant prior year AND more than 25 tonnes of packaging supplied — matching the draft's thresholds exactly. Reg. 25 is the actual registration/reporting obligation. SIGNED OFF 2026-09-20 (Tabeen Raoof): scoped explicitly to registration duties only (Option A), since registration applies to both small and large producers and that is what this row actually tests for today. Large-producer-only duties (PRNs/PERNs, compliance certificate, disposal fee) to be drafted as separate requirement(s) later.
